problem: ClayVerse has one canonical UnifiedDB entity and two concurrent user perspectives. Current main now has a global entity_generation for real boot/recovery and a strict global EntityOS-effect lease, but still no semantic rule defining which ordinary durable knowledge-state operations may commute and which require exact context revalidation/serialization.
mechanism: Classify canonical changes by information polarity. Immutable contradiction-preserving appends may commute inside the same live global entity generation. Resolution, retraction, absence/uniqueness assumptions, external effects and unknown operations cross a fail-closed causal aperture with exact context validation. Any boot/recovery generation advance invalidates all in-flight MCA operations. External effects retain the existing global EntityOS lease/generation/journal boundary.

measurement.surface: OpenAI isolated container reference simulation; non-VPS
measurement.interpretation: internal synthetic discriminator only; safety oracle is constructed around monotonicity and is not independent runtime validation
